{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[~df.index.isin(qa_orders.index)]

# Count completed orders in cleaned data
completed_count = df_clean['status'].value_counts()['completed']

# Print the final answer and required evidence
print(f"Number of completed orders: {completed_count}")
print(f"QA order count: {len(qa_orders)}")
print(f"QA order IDs: {list(qa_orders['order_id'])}")"}
